rationale: The parameter --diversity_rarefaction_depth only reaches QIIME2_DIVERSITY_CORE. That process raises the sampling depth to this floor when the shallowest sample falls below it, and qiime core-metrics then drops the samples under the depth. Its distance matrices, vectors, PCoA results and depth report feed the alpha, beta, ordination and adonis steps and SUMMARY_REPORT, so all of these re-run. The parameter summary sent to MultiQC also changes, so MULTIQC re-runs too.
